Cc: portal-admin@vendr.co
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal onboarding — minimal evidence + upload path

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this on. We have started a profile for Redwood Inference in the Vendr portal (link below). To get you into 'active' state we need a small initial set of artifacts and a short answers matrix for SIG/CAIQ. We try to keep the first pass minimal — enough for a typical SaaS scoping review — and then expand during the full assessment.

What we need from you to unlock the profile:
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (PDF) or SOC 2 summary + AICPA letter if full report is sensitive
- A CAIQ spreadsheet with high-level answers for the 50 most relevant questions (we can provide a template)
- A one-page system diagram showing data flows and where customer data is stored
- Primary contact name/email + preferred upload method (portal upload vs S3 presigned)

If you want an evidence-only role for a vendor admin, tell me the email and I can grant 'evidence uploader' permission — it will prevent edit of profile answers but allow file uploads.

Portal: https://vendorportal.vendr.co/organizations/redwood-inference/profile
Please reply with preferred contact and whether you’d like presigned S3 uploads or portal-only. We can keep this low friction and mark the profile as "Initial Complete" once those artifacts are present.

Best,
Maya
Maya Singh
Vendor Onboarding — Vendr

Hannah / Ben — quick notes from security's side:

We are OK with a redacted SOC 2 Type II (redact customer-specific sections) plus a one-page attestation summary. For CAIQ, provide concise answers and link to fuller docs if needed (avoid verbatim attaching large SOC artifacts unless requested). Minimal evidence matrix we prefer:

Mandatory initial artifacts (priority 1):
- SOC 2 attestation (PDF, redacted OK) — include report date and scope
- CAIQ 50-Q slice (spreadsheet) — mark any "unknown" with a short comment
- System architecture diagram (PNG/PDF) — show regions where customer data persists
- Encryption KMS ownership statement (one paragraph)

Nice-to-have (priority 2):
- Key rotation policy excerpt (PDF)
- Incident response summary (one pager)
- MFA POS and SSO configuration screenshot (if available)

Ben — please upload priority 1 artifacts to the portal once Maya grants you the role. Add filenames exactly as below when uploading so Vendr can match: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf, caiq-excerpt-answers.xlsx, system-architecture-diagram.png.

I'll be available for quick clarifications with the portal reviewer if they ping us.

Rishi
Director, Security & Compliance

Hi Hannah / Ben / Rishi,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I've granted ben.carter@redwoodinference.com the "Evidence Uploader (limited)" role in the portal — he should see an invite email with a magic link. A few implementation notes and the upload checklist:

Portal upload checklist (what our reviewers will check first):
- Filename and artifact type match (we index filenames; use the names Rishi called out)
- Report date and scope for SOC 2 clearly visible on the summary page
- CAIQ spreadsheet contains question IDs in column A and short answers in column B
- Architecture diagram must label data-at-rest locations and third-party integrations

Upload options: portal direct upload (recommended) or S3 presigned links if you prefer automation. Since you chose portal uploads, you can drop files directly under "Artifacts > Initial Intake".

I've attached a short CSV template for the CAIQ 50-slice and a DocuSign link for our data processing addendum if needed. Portal reviewers will flag anything they need; we'll mark the profile as "Intake Complete" once all priority 1 artifacts are present.

Portal link: https://vendorportal.vendr.co/organizations/redwood-inference/profile
